lede: The biggest thing on the docket this week is the Carhenge redevelopment, which hits two separate hearings on September 30 — HARC takes up the preliminary large-scale design review for all three building clusters at 700 W. Pacific, while a special Town Council session hears the appeal of the lot subdivision that P&Z approved back in July. Meanwhile, the Gondola Leadership Committee meets September 28 to weigh a consequential choice between federally funded and locally controlled project delivery, and P&Z holds a work session Wednesday on a proposed School District employee housing project at the middle-high school site.
